title.zh: 一句话定位：设计意图 vs写版确认
title.en: In one sentence: design intent versus mask-writing verification

subtitle.zh: GDS负责交付版图，JDV负责审查制造数据
subtitle.en: GDS delivers the layout; JDV reviews manufacturing data

body.zh: 版图完成；电路设计完成；版图绘制结束
body.en: Layout complete Circuit design complete Layout drawing finished

body.zh: DRC / LVS；设计规则检查；电路一致性检查
body.en: DRC / LVS Design-rule checks Circuit-consistency checks

body.zh: 3；输出GDS；.gds；导出GDSII数据；作为交付版图
body.en: 3 Output GDS .gds Export GDSII data as the delivered layout

body.zh: Mask Data Prep；版图处理与优化；生成制造数据
body.en: Mask data prep Process and optimize the layout Generate manufacturing data

body.zh: 5；生成JDV；.jdv；生成JDV数据；用于写版验证
body.en: 5 Generate JDV .jdv Generate JDV data for mask-writing verification

body.zh: Release写版；签核通过后；送入光罩写版
body.en: Release for mask writing After sign-off, send to mask writing

body.zh: GDS | 设计端；Cell · Polygon · Layer ·；设计意图；Layer；M1；VIA；M2；POLY；DIFF；抽象几何图形；逻辑层级结构；代表设计意图
body.en: GDS | design side Cell · polygon · layer · design intent Layer M1 VIA M2 POLY DIFF Abstract geometry Logical hierarchy Represents design intent

body.zh: MDP；（Mask Data Prep）；规则化/ 优化 / 修补；生成制造级数据
body.en: MDP (Mask Data Prep) Rule handling / optimization / correction Generate manufacturing-level data

body.zh: JDV | 制造端；Mask · Reticle · Job · 写版确认；制造级数据（考虑光学与工艺）；包含写版工艺与设备信息；用于写版前的签核确认
body.en: JDV | manufacturing side Mask · reticle · job · mask-writing verification Manufacturing data (accounting for optics and process) Includes mask-writing process and equipment information Used for sign-off before mask writing

body.zh: 责任方|设计团队 vs Fab /Mask Shop；设计团队；Fab / Mask Shop
body.en: Responsible parties | design team versus fab / mask shop Design team Fab / mask shop

body.zh: 流程阶段 | Tape-out输入 vs Mask Release前；设计；Tape-out；输入；Mask；Data Prep；Mask；Release 前；写版；.gds；.jdv
body.en: Process stage | tape-out input versus before mask release Design Tape-out input Mask data prep Before mask release Mask writing .gds .jdv

body.zh: 输出用途 | 版图交付 vs 写版签核；.gds；版图交付；写版签核
body.en: Output purpose | layout delivery versus mask-writing sign-off .gds Layout delivery Mask-writing sign-off

body.zh: 常见误区|把JDV当成另一种GDS；用错误阶段的数据直接比较
body.en: Common mistake | treating JDV as another GDS and comparing data from mismatched stages

body.zh: 验证反馈：形成闭环；GDS Sign-off；Revision映射；Checksum校验；JDV Release Log
body.en: Verification feedback: close the loop GDS sign-off Revision mapping Checksum validation JDV release log

body.zh: JDV底层格式和显示内容可能因Mask Shop与工具平台而异。
body.en: JDV underlying formats and displayed contents may vary by mask shop and tool platform
